_description: General on-screen text for the game. 'start' = the first screen (needed so the browser allows sound): 'prompt' is the main line, 'soundNote' the smaller line under it. 'title' = the opening page: 'heading' is the big game name, 'tagline' is an optional line under it (leave "" to hide), 'enterButton' is the button label, 'hint' is the small text under the button. 'sequence' = the intro slides: 'nextHint' is the small text in the caption box telling players how to continue, 'backButton' is the label of the button that goes to the previous slide.
_usedIn: Simulation page → Start screen, Title screen (opening page), Intro slides

start._location: Very first screen, dark background, before the opening page
start.soundNote: This experience uses sound. Headphones are recommended.

title._location: Opening page, centered over the bright valley landscape
title.heading: Datadew Valley
title.hint: Click Enter or press the Enter key  ·  Press M to mute

sequence._location: Intro slides: bottom of the caption box
sequence.nextHint: Click or press Enter to continue
